customConfig.name: aboutIntro
customConfig.label: Intro line (shown in italics)
customConfig.value: I'm Cassie Broll — a licensed counselor specializing in holistic, somatic, trauma-informed care for the kind folks of Minnesota.

customConfig.name: aboutP1
customConfig.label: Bio paragraph 1
customConfig.value: Life's hard, isn't it? Most of us go through our days thinking we're all alone, we're the problem, or we need to be 'fixed.' The truth is, there's a lot more right with you than you give yourself credit for.

customConfig.name: aboutP2
customConfig.label: Bio paragraph 2
customConfig.value: Therapy is a messy, playful, and sacred journey to discover this for yourself. My role is to help create a space for you to explore all the parts of you and your story. While you'll surely run into heartbreak and grief, you might be surprised to find there's much more treasure within you than you could ever realize alone.

customConfig.name: aboutP3
customConfig.label: Bio paragraph 3
customConfig.value: Once we spend time in your story, you'll find that you make so much sense. Your nervous system created incredibly wise ways to keep you safe when you were younger. Together, we'll help those parts get the care they need so you can show up in ways that feel better today.

customConfig.name: differentLead
customConfig.label: Section intro
customConfig.value: Six things that shape how we work together.

value.title: We welcome all parts of you
value.text: Ever feel like one part of you wants to change and another wants to stay exactly the same? Very human. Our work helps you make sense of all those parts so you feel more integrated and connected.

value.title: We focus on your needs
value.text: Don't know what your needs are? Or does the idea of having needs make your stomach turn? You'll find out what needs you do have, why they've had to be dismissed, and how to begin honoring them.

value.title: We embrace emotions
value.text: If you've ever apologized for crying, you're not alone. You'll do some healthy unlearning about emotions and explore why they're showing up and the wisdom they offer in the present moment.

value.title: We center the relationship
value.text: Therapy is a microcosm of your outside world — what shows up there will show up here. That's great news: you'll have a safe, nonjudgmental place to explore those dynamics and practice being assertive.

value.title: We help you come back to your body
value.text: Your body might be the single most underrated tool you have. You'll learn about your nervous system and discover how to be in your body instead of spending so much energy trying to get out of it.

value.title: We guide you to more of yourself
value.text: The world is a richer place when you show up as fully and authentically you. The work centers around helping you have more of yourself so you can show up in ways aligned with who you truly are.

customConfig.name: specialtiesLead

value.title: Somatic Therapy
value.text: Somatic Experiencing helps alleviate trauma and brings you into a fuller relationship with yourself — more capacity for life's challenges while staying connected to yourself.

value.title: Trauma Therapy
value.text: Curious if you have stories of trauma that need care? Holistic therapy and counseling for trauma healing, offered with curiosity and care — never rush.

value.title: Anxiety Therapy
value.text: I want you to enjoy your coffee without worrying if it'll spike your anxiety! Your anxiety needs care, and a holistic approach can help it soften.

value.title: Disordered Eating & Body
value.text: Struggling with your relationship to food and/or your body? You're in the right place. Healing, growth, and a kinder relationship with your body are possible.

value.title: Friendship Therapy
value.text: Yes, you read that right. Friendships are cornerstone relationships that rarely get the care they deserve. Therapy for two friends who want to repair and grow together.

value.title: Grief & Transitions
value.text: Honoring what's been lost — a person, a relationship, a role, a chapter. Compassionate support for navigating change at your own pace.

customConfig.name: faqIntro
customConfig.label: Intro text (beside the questions)
customConfig.value: Starting therapy brings up a lot of questions — that's more than okay. Here are the ones I hear most often.

value.question: How long is each session?
value.answer: Standard sessions are 50 minutes. Extended 80-minute sessions are available for couples or deeper trauma-focused work if we decide that's right for you.

value.question: Do you accept insurance?
value.answer: I'm an out-of-network provider. I'll provide a monthly superbill you can submit to your insurer for potential reimbursement. I'm glad to help you check your benefits before we begin.

value.question: What are your rates?
value.answer: Individual sessions are $165 and couples/friendship sessions are $215. A limited number of sliding-scale slots are available — please don't hesitate to ask.

value.question: Online or in-person?
value.answer: Both. Telehealth happens on a secure, HIPAA-compliant platform, and in-person sessions are held at my Minnesota office. Many folks do a mix of the two.

value.question: How do I know if we're a good fit?
value.answer: That's exactly what the free 15–20 minute consultation is for. It's a low-pressure conversation to see if my style and approach feel right for you. If not, I'm glad to offer referrals.

value.question: Is everything confidential?
value.answer: Yes. Your privacy is protected by law and by my own ethical commitment. The only exceptions are standard legal duties around imminent harm, which we'll discuss in our first session.
